description: Class representing a slide show transition.

GetAdvanceOnClick.description: Returns whether the slide advances on mouse click.

returns.description: True if the slide advances on mouse click; otherwise false.

GetAdvanceOnTime.description: Returns whether the slide advances after a specified time.

returns.description: True if the slide advances after a specified time; otherwise false.

GetAdvanceTime.description: Returns the slide advance time in milliseconds.

returns.description: The slide advance time in milliseconds if set; otherwise undefined.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiSlideShowTransition class.

GetDuration.description: Returns the transition duration in milliseconds for the slide show transition.

GetEntryEffect.description: Returns the entry effect for the slide show transition.

returns.description: The name of the entry effect in string format.

GetSpeed.description:
Returns the transition speed (similar to PowerPoint VBA Speed property).
Maps duration to speed based on OOXML spd attribute logic:
- fast: duration <= 500ms
- medium: 500ms < duration <= 750ms
- slow: duration > 750ms

returns.description: The transition speed in string format.

SetAdvanceOnClick.description: Sets whether the slide advances on mouse click.

params.description: True to advance the slide on mouse click; otherwise false.
params.name: advanceOnClick

returns.description: True if the value was set successfully; otherwise false.

SetAdvanceOnTime.description: Sets whether the slide advances after a specified time.

params.description: True to advance the slide after a specified time; otherwise false.
params.name: advanceOnTime

returns.description: True if the setting was set successfully; otherwise false.

SetAdvanceTime.description: Sets the slide advance time in milliseconds.

params.description: The slide advance time in milliseconds.
params.name: advanceTime

returns.description: True if the time was set successfully; otherwise false.

SetDuration.description: Sets the transition duration in milliseconds for the slide show transition.

returns.description: True if the duration was set successfully; otherwise false.

SetEntryEffect.description: Sets the entry effect for the slide show transition.

params.description: The name of the entry effect in string format.
params.name: entryEffectName

returns.description: True if the entry effect name is supported and was set successfully; otherwise false.

SetSpeed.description:
Sets the transition speed (similar to PowerPoint VBA Speed property).
Converts speed to duration based on standard values:
- fast = 500ms
- medium = 750ms
- slow = 1000ms

params.description: The transition speed in string format.
params.name: speed

returns.description: True if the given parameter is valid and was set successfully; otherwise false.
